versions.changelog:
- Version bump: 1.6.0.
- Added support for the new video model `video-seedance-2` (up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos, 3 audio, 4–15 sec, 480p/720p/1080p, whitelist required).
- Updated documentation: Video model endpoints are now specific per model (`/video-v1-fast` and `/video-seedance-2`); old `/video-generation` endpoint is removed.
- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.

aoment-image-video 1.5.0

- Added support for Gemini 3.5 Flash image recognition with new model `image-recognition-g2`.
- Introduced new default video model `video-v1-fast` (faster Veo 3.1, supports reference image and variable durations).
- Expanded model descriptions and updated available model lists, including advanced video and recognition models.
- Documentation updated to reflect new models, parameter defaults, and backend service changes.

Version 1.4.0

- Added support for the new video model "video-v1-fast" (Veo 3.1) with 4/6/8 second duration options and single reference image.
- Expanded the list of available video models and updated the "video-generation" parameters to include new resolution and duration options.
- Updated SKILL.md documentation to reflect these changes, including parameter tables and model descriptions.

**Version 1.3.0**

- Added image recognition/analyze feature using the Gemini 3.1 Pro model.
- Documentation updated to include image recognition usage and model details.
- Description expanded to cover Gemini 3.1 Pro, image recognition, and related capabilities.
- Quick Start and parameter tables updated to reflect the new image recognition tool.

aoment-image-video 1.2.0

- Added new O2-Pro model ("image-o2-pro") for high-resolution image generation and editing with precise size output.
- Updated documentation to include "image-o2-pro" in supported models and usage examples.
- Clarified instructions for securely storing your API key.
- Bumped reported version to 1.2.0 in all documentation and update checks.

**Summary:**  
Version 1.1.0 adds HD image repair/upscale support and updates documentation for expanded model and tool coverage.

- Added a new script: `scripts/aoment_hd_repair.py` for image HD repair/upscale.
- Expanded SKILL.md documentation to include usage and parameters for the new HD repair tool.
- Updated model descriptions and available tool types.
- Refreshed getting started and usage examples to reflect new capabilities.

- Initial release of the aoment-image-video skill (version 1.0.0)
- Renamed the skill from aoment-visuals to aoment-image-video
- Replaced script: added scripts/aoment_image_video.py, removed scripts/aoment_visuals.py
- Updated documentation with a new auto-update/version check policy and instructions
- All previous features for text-to-image, image-to-image, and video-generation are retained
Automatic API key registration supported for limited-time free access
